name: High-value possible overdue — review required
sql: SELECT * FROM mailbox.possible_overdue ORDER BY amount DESC

name: Invoice candidates by currency (not ledger balances)
sql: SELECT currency, direction, count(*) AS invoices, sum(amount) AS candidate_amount FROM mailbox.transaction_candidates WHERE kind='invoice' GROUP BY currency,direction ORDER BY currency,direction

name: Vendor payment-method evidence
sql: SELECT * FROM mailbox.vendor_payment_methods ORDER BY last_seen DESC

name: Finance contacts
sql: SELECT * FROM mailbox.finance_contacts ORDER BY last_seen DESC

name: Transaction source evidence
sql: SELECT * FROM mailbox.source_evidence ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1000

name: Sync progress and errors
sql: SELECT * FROM mailbox.sync_health ORDER BY stream

name: Extraction queue health
sql: SELECT * FROM mailbox.extraction_health ORDER BY status

name: All transaction candidates
sql: SELECT * FROM mailbox.transaction_candidates ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1000
